The first hemistich of AVS 2.6.3 stands as the first line of this leaf but that mantra is recorded on leaf n30, where it begins. Accent policy: superscript stroke = U+0951, subscript line = U+0952, located by mechanical connected-component detection above the headline / below the baseline and attributed by eye; accent PLACEMENT is best-effort, the akṣara sequence is the primary reading. text_devanagari: क्ष॒त्रेणा॑ग्ने॒ स्वेन॒ सं र॑भ॒स्व मि॒त्रेणा॑ग्ने मित्र॒धा यत॑स्व॒ । स॒जा॒तानां॑ मध्यमे॒ष्ठा राज्ञा॑मग्ने वि॒हव्यो॑ दीदि॒ही॒ह ॥ ४ ॥
अति॒ निहो॒ अति॒ स्रि॒धो ऽत्यचि॑त्ती॒रति॑ द्विषः॑ । विश्वा॒ ह्यग्ने॑ दुरि॒ता तर॑ त्वमथा॒स्मभ्यं॑ स॒ह॒वी॑रं॒ र॒यिं दाः॑ ॥ ५ ॥

structural_marker: sūkta-opening numeral ॥ ७ ॥ printed in the right (outer) margin of this line
text_devanagari: अघ॒द्वि॑ष्टा दे॒वजा॑ता वी॒रुच्छ॑पथ॒योप॑नी । आपो॒ मल॑मिव प्रा॒णैक्षी॒त्सर्वा॒न्मच्छ॒पथाँ॒ अधि॑ ॥ १ ॥
यश्च॑ सा॒पत्नः॒ शप॒थो जा॒म्याः श॒पथ॑श्च॒ यः । ब्र॒ह्मा यन्म॑न्युतः श॒पात्सर्वं॒ तन्नो॑ अध॒स्पदम् ॥ २ ॥
दि॒वो मू॒ल॒मव॑ततं पृथि॒व्या अध्युत्त॑तम् । तेन॑ स॒हस्र॑काण्डेन॒ परि॑ णः पाहि॒ विश्वतः॑ ॥ ३ ॥
परी॒मां परि॑ मे प्र॒जां परि॑ णः पाहि॒ यद्धन॑म् । अरा॑तिर्नो॒ मा ता॑री॒न्मा नस्ता॑रि॒षु॒रभिमा॑तयः ॥ ४ ॥

notes: The second akṣara of the first word (a conjunct with a subscript ्र and an ā-mātrā, between श and the following र) could not be decided between प्रा and म्रा at this resolution and is left as [?].
text_devanagari: श॒[?]ार॑मेतु शप॒थो यः सु॒हार्ते॑न नः स॒ह । चक्षु॑र्मन्त्रस्य दु॒र्हा॒र्दः पृ॒ष्टीरपि॑ शृणीमसि ॥ ५ ॥

structural_marker: sūkta-opening numeral ॥ ८ ॥ printed in the right (outer) margin of this line
text_devanagari: उद्गा॑तां॒ भग॑वती वि॒चृतौ॒ नाम॒ तार॑के । वि क्षे॑त्रि॒यस्य॑ मुञ्चतामध॒मं पाश॑मुत्त॒मम् ॥ १ ॥

notes: The refrain is not written out: the page prints वीरु॒त्॰ with the Devanagari abbreviation sign. The mantra number ॥ ३ ॥ is not on this line at all — it is set in the right margin of the FOLLOWING line, because this line runs the full measure. It is supplied here at the end of the unit.
text_devanagari: ब॒भ्रोर॑र्जुनका॒ण्डस्य॒ यव॑स्य ते पला॒ल्या ति॒लस्य॑ तिलपि॒ञ्ज्या । वीरु॒त्॰ ॥ ३ ॥

notes: Refrain again abbreviated as वीरु॒त्॰. The marginal ॥ ३ ॥ standing to the right of this line belongs to the preceding mantra, not to this one.
Foot of the page carries the catchword अथर्ववेद at the left and the gathering signature ३ at the right.
text_devanagari: नमः॑ सनिस्रसा॒क्षेभ्यो॒ नमः॑ संदे॒श्येभ्यो॒ नमः॑ क्षेत्र॑स्य॒ पत॑ये । वी॒रुत्क्षेत्रि॒यनाश॒न्यप॑ क्षेत्रि॒यमु॑च्छतु ॥ ५ ॥
